title: Hinomori Shiho — Important Preparations〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Live House

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: Then, we'll go with this date.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay, thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: Alright, Leo/need now has a venue booked for their solo show...

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: Next, you'll have to start working on all the other preparations for it. Between rehearsals and gathering your audience, I know it's gonna be a lot, so I wish you good luck.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I really appreciate it.
Even after giving us a rental discount...

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line:
Don't worry about that.
I'm just happy that I get to be a part of your very first solo show, Hinomori.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: I worry about most bands since they usually have trouble turning a profit with a solo show, but I'm much more optimistic about you now, Hinomori...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thank you...

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line:
Also, here's the equipment list...
Actually, you probably have everything memorized already, don't you...?

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: And here are the papers you'll need to fill out, including the ones for your timetable and stage layout.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: I'm guessing that your band still doesn't have a finalized set list yet, but we'll want that sooner rather than later.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Understood.
I'll tell the others about that and try to get it to you as quickly as possible.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line:
Okay.
Please feel free to ask if you have any questions.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: Anyway, why don't you get started with work? Our act for today should be here soon.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay, I'll start preparing.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I still have some time before I have to get their equipment set up, so I'll take a quick look at these papers...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Let's see... We'll need to write up a member list, a stage layout and a timetable... I'll give these to Honami tomorrow...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We'll be playing a lot more songs than usual, so we're gonna need to also think about what effects we want to use...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Since it's gonna be just us, we can come up with a more intricate sound scheme. It might be nice to have Ichika's guitar solos stand out more.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: However, above all else, this is gonna be about the way we perform... We'll need to practice like we really mean it.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: A solo show...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Our solo show... It's really happening...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Alright, that's it for the equipment... Next, I need to...)

rows.Speaker: Staff A
rows.Line:
Hey, Hinomori!
Do you remember which amps the second band's gonna use for their guitar?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: These ones. They're all set up.

rows.Speaker: Staff A
rows.Line: Nice! Thanks for doing that. You work so fast.

rows.Speaker: Staff B
rows.Line: Hey, Shiho, I heard from the manager that Leo/need's doing a solo show! Is that true?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yes, it is.
We decided to do one fairly recently...

rows.Speaker: Staff A
rows.Line: Wait, really?! Where?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Here.
I just set a date with the manager.

rows.Speaker: Staff A
rows.Line:
Seriously...?!
Whoa! Leo/need's finally doing a show all by themselves...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I honestly thought that we still weren't ready to do one, but we decided to go for it...

rows.Speaker: Staff B
rows.Line:
No way. You're totally ready!
I mean, you girls are so good now!

rows.Speaker: Staff A
rows.Line:
I agree.
You were all really good to start, but it's amazing how far you've come recently.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (That means a lot coming from them since they've seen so many bands come and go...)

rows.Speaker: Staff B
rows.Line:
Good luck.
I'm sure it's gonna go great!

rows.Speaker: Staff A
rows.Line:
Yeah.
We've been watching your progress since the beginning, so we know what we're talking about!

rows.Speaker: Staff B
rows.Line: Hey, I get that you're proud of them, but you're putting a lot of pressure on Shiho.

rows.Speaker: Staff A
rows.Line:
Of course I'm proud!
They're even playing here! That means we need to do our absolute best for them as the staff!

rows.Speaker: Staff B
rows.Line: True. It is their very first solo show, so I get why you're so excited to help them out!

rows.Speaker: Staff B
rows.Line: So, Shiho, are there any specific effects that you wanna use? You can use all the lights and smoke as you like!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What you do for the other bands should be more than enough. I'd rather we not be given any special treatment...

rows.Speaker: Staff B
rows.Line: Hehe. We're offering because you're all so modest and have an incredible work ethic.

rows.Speaker: Staff A
rows.Line:
Exactly.
And Hinomori, you work so hard here and are a great sub.

rows.Speaker: Staff B
rows.Line: Not only that, your band produces great songs and each member's really nice. It's only natural for us to feel more motivated than usual.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: The others will definitely like hearing that bit...

rows.Speaker: Staff B
rows.Line:
Hehe.
Anyway, as Leo/need fans, we want to give your band as much support as we can.

rows.Speaker: Staff A
rows.Line: Right. So, don't hesitate to ask us for anything. Let us help you put on the best show possible.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay, thank you both very much...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: If we feel that we're going to need your help, we'll make sure to ask...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I didn't realize that we had such valuable supporters hiding right under our noses...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (All the more reason to make sure our show succeeds...)
